standard.title: Refine safe dance and genre techniques
standard.description: develop and refine safe dance practice, expressive and technical skills and genre- or style-specific techniques
standard.prior_knowledge: Students have developed safe dance practice and technical/expressive skills (Y7-8, AC9ADA8D01). They can extend their movement vocabulary through improvisation and work with genre/style-specific techniques.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students develop and refine safe dance practice, expressive and technical skills and genre- or style-specific techniques.

nodes.label: Refining technical precision
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can refine technical skills — control, accuracy, strength, balance, alignment, flexibility, endurance, coordination, articulation — through self-reflection and targeted practice.
nodes.minimum_width: Setting a specific technical skill development goal; practising with targeted self-reflection; demonstrating improvement in one technical quality.
nodes.typical_width: Refining technical skills in response to self-reflection: developing safe dance practice and control, accuracy, strength, balance, alignment, flexibility, endurance, coordination, articulation; using experimentation and improvisation to develop techniques for executing expressive skills in a range of genres/styles.
wider: Develop a sustained personal technical development plan — setting measurable targets across two or three skills over an extended period
Explore how technical training approaches differ across dance genres — comparing the physical demands and preparation methods of two different styles

response_modes.reason: Technical precision at senior level requires deliberate, focused practice — not just exposure. Set specific quality targets for each session and create conditions for productive repetition.

nodes.width_opportunity_reason: Students who develop technical range across multiple genre/style vocabularies — not just in a single style — build physical versatility that supports sophisticated, personally driven choreographic and performance choices.
success_criteria: Student identifies a specific technical skill development goal and can articulate what improvement looks like
Student demonstrates measurable improvement in a target technical skill following focused practice

nodes.label: Genre/style proficiency
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can practise and refine genre- and style-specific techniques toward developing proficiency.
nodes.minimum_width: Demonstrating proficiency in at least two characteristic techniques of a selected genre/style — with attention to both technical quality and stylistic authenticity.
nodes.typical_width: Practising and refining technical skills to develop proficiency in genre- and style-specific techniques; using experimentation and improvisation to develop expressive technique execution; applying safe dance practice as complexity and demand increase.
wider: Pursue proficiency in techniques from a genre/style associated with a cultural identity or tradition — engaging with community knowledge where possible
Compare how proficiency is understood and assessed across two genres — exploring what counts as excellence in each context
nodes.hinge_reason: Genre/style proficiency is the technical foundation of the senior Presenting strand — students performing in formal contexts must have sufficient genre-specific technique to communicate authentically, not just approximately.

response_modes.reason: Proficiency requires accumulated repetition across extended time. Frame genre/style technique development as a long arc — not a unit. Identify technique benchmarks and return to them across the year.

success_criteria: Student demonstrates proficiency in at least two genre- or style-specific techniques — evidencing both technical quality and stylistic awareness
Student applies safe dance practice consistently as technical demands increase
